versions.subject: Added rule for zero day CVE-2021-22123 in Fortinet WAFs
versions.detection:
selection:
    c-uri|contains: 
        - '/api/v2.0/user/remoteserver.saml'
    cs-method:
        - POST
    content-type|startswith:
        - 'multipart/form-data;'
    content-disposition|contains:
        - '`'
condition: selection

versions.subject: Update web_fortinet_cve_2021_22123_exploit.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    c-uri|contains: 
        - '/api/v2.0/user/remoteserver.saml'
    cs-method:
        - POST
filter1:
    cs-referer|contains: '/root/user/remote-user/saml-user/'
filter2:
    cs-referer:
        - null
condition: selection and not filter1 and not filter2
